title: LineageOS support finally comes to the Galaxy S22 series
summary: The S23 series isn’t one of the lucky 7-year update plan devices. Anyone with the Galaxy S22, S22+, and S22 Ultra is now able to get LineageOS 23 nightly builds and get Android 16 on their phones .
